groups.saying_opens: أن النبي قيل له يا رسول الله متى يخرج القائم

notes: two sayings: the Imam's words to Dik'bal on the successors (saying 1), and the Imam's own chain, through his father, forefathers and Ali, for the Prophet's words on al-Qa'im (saying 2); saying 2 keeps the head up to the Imam, as in example 3
the Imam is the last link of saying 1 (owner ruling 5) and a middle narrator of saying 2, written as narrator there
«آبائه» is a collective surface with no name, read as unnamed; the occurrence index for «علي» is its fifth appearance in the text (Ali, not the Imam Ali b. Musa)
the title «خبر دعبل عند وفاته» is left out
